column3: the mid-tower case alone (no internal parts): glass panel and solid back panel pulled off, PSU shroud with the G4 riser, all grommets G0-G6, 9 standoffs, 7 PCIe slot covers, front mesh with 3x120 fan mounts, top radiator mount, rear 120 fan mount, PSU rear opening with 4 screw holes, front I/O cluster (power button, 2x USB-A 3.0, audio jack). Small inset: the cable side of the tray.

the generic ATX motherboard alone, face-on hero view plus a small angled view. LGA socket with load plate and lever, 4 DIMM slots (A1 A2 B1 B2), 3 PCIe slots with the first x16 reinforced, 1 M.2 slot with standoff, ATX 24-pin, EPS 8-pin, AIO_PUMP, CPU_FAN, SYS_FAN1-4, F_PANEL, USB 3.0 19-pin, HD_AUDIO headers, rear I/O shield, 9 mounting holes. Dark matte PCB, subtle silver heatsinks over VRM and chipset, no logos.

the generic LGA CPU hovering just above the open socket, plus a small view of the CPU underside with flat gold contact pads; triangle mark, two orientation notches, socket lever direction. No screws on CPU.

the 240 mm AIO liquid cooler: round pump block (cyan accent ring, no logo) with mounting bracket, two sleeved hoses, 240 radiator with fill port, the two 120 fans pulled off, 4 spring pump screws, 8 long fan screws, 8 short roof screws, airflow arrows, AIO_PUMP and CPU_FAN connectors with a Y splitter.

two DDR4 RAM sticks with dark heatspreaders (thin cyan top edge accent), shown hovering above slots A2/B2 of a DIMM strip, plus a zoomed cutaway of the off-centre key notch matching the slot key and the slot latches open/closed. Gold edge fingers visible.

the graphics card. IMPORTANT: make it look like a familiar mainstream NVIDIA GeForce RTX card so beginners recognise it instantly (matte black shroud with dark gunmetal/silver angular accents, three axial fans, black metal backplate with vent cut, silver 2-slot bracket with 3 DisplayPort + 1 HDMI, gold PCIe x16 fingers with the retention notch, one 8-pin PCIe power socket on the top edge), BUT absolutely no logo, no 'GeForce'/'RTX'/'NVIDIA' text or any brand. Hero view from below at 3/4 showing the 3 fans, small view of the bracket and the 8-pin socket, 2 bracket screws.

the M.2 2280 NVMe SSD: plain dark PCB with 2 flash chips + controller (no labels/brand stickers), M-key edge fingers, half-moon screw notch; shown being inserted at an angle into the M.2 slot, then pressed down onto the 3 mm standoff with one M2 screw.

the ATX power supply with fixed (non-modular) cables: rear view with IEC C14 inlet, rocker switch, honeycomb vent and the 4 screw holes, bottom intake fan with grille, cable exit at the front end with a tidy bundle (24-pin, 8-pin CPU EPS, 6+2 PCIe) shown with their connectors and latches.

one 120 mm case fan exploded with its 4 screws (frame, 7-9 blades, hub, anti-vibration corners, 4-pin PWM cable with its connector and key), airflow and rotation arrows moulded on the frame; small inset of the case showing the 3 front intake + 1 rear exhaust positions.

all internal cables laid out neatly on a light background as a 'cable kit': ATX 24-pin (20+4), EPS 8-pin (4+4), PCIe 6+2, AIO pump 4-pin, fan Y-splitter, 4x fan 4-pin, front-panel leads (PWR SW, RESET SW, PLED +/-, HDD LED +/-), USB 3.0 19-pin, HD_AUDIO; each connector shown close up with pin count, latch and key, plus a small inset of the back of the tray with the tidy routes through G0-G6.
